entities.summary: Hasköy is a town in Muş Province of the Eastern Anatolia region of Turkey. It is the seat of Hasköy District. Hasköy was elected from the MHP in the 2024 Turkish Local Elections, with Cemal Orbay serving as the mayor. According to the 2024 population census, the district's total population is 26,336.
